# FlatBuffers headers

The files in this directory are vendored from:

- Repository: <https://github.com/google/flatbuffers>
- Commit: `5761d6e67af841d15ee21bc1ce9a78ffa9cf939e`
- Header and `flatc` version: `25.12.19`

Only the C++ headers under `include/flatbuffers` and the upstream `LICENSE` are
included. Use `build/RegenerateFlatbuffers.ps1` to validate and update this copy
alongside the generated C++ binding.
